items.name: 领域概念
items.definition: 领域概念：A simplifying statement about system operation made due to complexity or ignorance of all relevant factors.。

items.name: Designing the control law
items.definition: Designing the control law：Designing the control law as if all state variables are measured and available for use.

items.name: angle of departure
items.definition: angle of departure：The angle at which a locus leaves a complex pole in the s-plane.
